goal: Publish a verified remediation release of VII to the existing temporary public site without regressing booking or discovery.

intent_model.implied_outcome: Fix the verified audit blockers, release a coherent version, and prove it works publicly.
likely_rejections: Calling a local build a release
Claiming unverified infrastructure or accessibility completion

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Authorization to publish one verified candidate to the current temporary public VII destination.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Requires exact deployed-version verification and rollback evidence.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Release blockers and preserved critical journeys
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Whether one candidate is safe to publish
cognitive_flow.next_action: Publish only after the gate passes

facts.claim: Public version 531 restored the vacation booking flow.
facts.evidence: Current deployment record and commit c7e2d47.

facts.claim: The comprehensive audit found public test inventory and multiple shared visual/performance defects.
VII Sites releases use the existing dedicated cloud publication task for appgprj_6a71ccdca27481918bf04dd329d3eb21 when the local Sites connector cannot resolve the project.
facts.evidence: Versions 531 and 532 were saved and deployed successfully through the existing dedicated publication task; a local project_not_found response is not a reason to ask Adir to reconnect Sites.

assumptions.claim: The current Sites project remains the public deployment target.
assumptions.validation: Read project/version/deployment identity immediately before publication.

in_scope: Remove public test inventory through a durable public-boundary guard
Preserve and verify cached undated online discovery and dated booking
Repair affected room, card, slider and mobile layout defects
Exclude invalid managed search pages from public discovery
Repair first-viewport localization gaps that can be verified
Build, test, publish and post-deploy verify one candidate
invariants: Undated online filter uses last-known-good cached capability data
Phone and WhatsApp remain separate actions
Temporary public host remains noindex until primary cutover
Illustrative media never impersonates a real business

requirements.statement: Known test inventory is absent from every public discovery and index surface.
Undated online filtering is instant from cache and dated booking remains functional.
requirements.source: User corrections and VII feedback standard

requirements.statement: Nearby discovery never traps the user in a long or permanent loading state.
Affected rooms, cards, images and rails are visually coherent and fully navigable on desktop and mobile.
Invalid managed pages and incomplete localization do not remain public defects in the released family.
The exact candidate is built, tested, published with rollback, and verified at the public destination.
Before escalating a VII Sites access error to Adir, reuse the established dedicated publication task and verify the exact project, commit, version and deployment there.
requirements.source: Adir correction after repeated unnecessary Sites reconnection requests

acceptance_checks.action: Open homepage, relevant rails, online search and sitemap
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No known test name, slug or phone appears and no public detail route is discoverable.

acceptance_checks.action: Reload undated online-filtered search while supplier refresh is unavailable
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Last-known-good eligible results remain visible without a blank state.

acceptance_checks.action: Open an eligible vacation and proceed through booking
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Availability resolves and the booking action does not dead-end.
Loading ends quickly and a manual location path is available.

acceptance_checks.action: Inspect and operate affected room, spa, event and provider families
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No broken image, clipping, accidental scrollbar, giant empty panel or blocked whole-card navigation.

acceptance_checks.setup: Invalid managed page input or incomplete localized route
acceptance_checks.observable_result: It is excluded, noindexed or replaced by valid localized content without malformed copy.

acceptance_checks.setup: Candidate ready and current version pinned
acceptance_checks.action: Verify deployment identity and rollback path, then publish
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Exact new version is public and prior version remains recoverable.

acceptance_checks.action: Run representative customer, operator, business and risk journeys including reload and back
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No high or critical failure remains; otherwise rollback or repair once with causal evidence.

acceptance_checks.setup: The root task receives project_not_found from the local Sites connector
acceptance_checks.action: Open the established dedicated VII publication task and reconcile the intended operation there
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Publication proceeds or yields a precise terminal blocker without asking Adir to repeat the known connection procedure.

authorization_boundary: One public release to the current temporary target is authorized. Primary DNS, destructive data deletion, real transactions, messaging and certification are not.
